newsitem.title: USA: Plains feedlot cattle bid $72, no sales - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: Plains feedlot cattle bid $72, no sales - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains cattle markets early Tuesday were quiet, with no major sales activity seen until Wednesday or Thursday, feedlot sources said.

Packers were lightly bidding $72.00 per cwt, steady with light sales Monday and unchanged from last week's top price. But cattle feeders were pricing cattle at $74.00 with some willing to sell at $73.00, sources said.
Fed cattle prices were expected to be supported this week by smaller numbers of market-ready cattle than last week, and by continued strength in wholesale beef prices.
